_comment: PLACEHOLDER. The sa mode raises before this file is ever read (see modes/sa.py).
It exists so the mode's prompt_config_path points somewhere real.
TODO: write a template for the stacked-audio condition. The one thing it must
NOT do is borrow PA's wording. PA's prompt says audio 1 is the participant's
own voice and audio 2 is everyone else; SA has a single soundtrack containing
everyone including the participant, so the prompt has to say that voices are
mixed and not separable. Claiming otherwise would tell the model something
false about its own input, which is worse than saying nothing.
Templates render against the record's flattened fields, so {participant} gives
the person of interest. {conversation_floor} does not render -- it is a list,
and the flattener keeps only scalars; see how modes/fa.py supplies {goa_ids}
through render_user_prompt if SA needs the group listed.
system_prompt: You are a helpful multimodal assistant.
